name: cardano.nexus
description: A decentralised, permissionless connection layer for the Cardano ecosystem — an open community proposal grounded in the 4Cs (Curious · Caring · Constructive · Chill). This A2N (agent to nexus) card uses the A2A AgentCard format and describes the proposal as published today: plain-text and JSON files an agent can read (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, data/index.json). The platform and its Verified Context Graph are not live yet; skills marked 'Planned' arrive with the MVP. Read access is permissionless.

skills.name: cardano.nexus overview (machine-readable)
skills.description: Explain what cardano.nexus is and is not: the 4Cs operating model, seven platform layers, design principles, the five user journeys, the Verified Context Graph, self-governance phases and the MVP feature set. Sources: https://cardano.nexus/llms.txt (short map), https://cardano.nexus/llms-full.txt (all content), https://cardano.nexus/data/index.json (structured, schema at /data/index.schema.json). Status: proposal — describe features as proposed.
examples: What will the cardano.nexus MVP include?

skills.name: cardano.nexus MVP Treasury proposal (draft)
skills.description: Answer questions about the draft Treasury Withdrawal that would fund the cardano.nexus MVP: ₳350,000 over about six months in four milestones (M1 Foundations, M2 Directory & Context, M3 Contribution & Trust, M4 API, Learning & Launch), budget by milestone and category, acceptance criteria, success metrics, constitutional alignment and risks. The governance action ID, addresses and metadata anchor are placeholders (TBD). Not financial or legal advice. Source: https://cardano.nexus/treasury-proposal
examples: How much is the cardano.nexus treasury proposal asking for?
What are the acceptance criteria for milestone M2?
How is the budget split by category?

skills.name: Governance Context
skills.description: Explain Cardano governance in context: the seven governance action types and which bodies ratify each (DReps, SPOs, Constitutional Committee), the propose → discuss → vote → ratify → enact lifecycle, and the proposed gov.cardano.nexus layer and roadmap. Never advises how to vote. Planned: live, per-action context pages (summaries, constitutional sections, DRep rationales, timelines). Source: https://cardano.nexus/governance
examples: What are the steps from a governance proposal to enactment?

skills.name: Ecosystem Discovery (planned)
skills.description: Planned for the MVP, not yet available: find projects, people, tools, standards and communities — who is building what, and where help is needed. Until it is live, point developers to https://cardano.build for Cardano tools, SDKs and infrastructure.
examples: Which projects work on decentralised identity?

skills.name: Contribution Matching (planned)
skills.description: Planned for the MVP, not yet available: surface open tasks, bounties and collaboration requests — recognising far more than code.
examples: What open tasks match a Plutus developer?

skills.name: Learning Pathways (planned)
skills.description: Planned for the MVP, not yet available: role-based onboarding, beginner pathways, governance education and a navigable glossary.
examples: I'm new to Cardano — where do I begin?

skills.name: Context Graph Query (planned)
skills.description: Planned for the MVP, not yet available: query ecosystem memory — dependencies, contributors, what funded a piece of work, the debates that shaped a decision — with answers linked to signed claims and evidence.
examples: Which tools depend on this library?
